后，以下接口和生命周期发生变化：\n+\n+- V1 worker、ModelRunner、worker 初始化和 pipeline-parallel metadata 的接口发生变化。\n+- upstream runner 中直接使用的 CUDA stream、event、UVA、CUDA 扩展和 `vllm._C` 路径，在 EMPTY/厂商设备上不能直接照搬。\n+- vLLM 0.32 的 compilation、CachedOp、IR 注册和 graph wrapper 生命周期与旧版不同。\n+- routed expert、MoE router、视觉归约、KV cache 和图捕获内存管理的实现位置发生变化。\n+- 上游默认的通用 CUDA 假设不适用于 Iluvatar 的 `is_cuda()` / `is_cuda_alike()` 语义和 CoreX 运行时。\n+\n+本次不是重新实现整个 vLLM，而是在上游 vLLM 0.32.0 源码基础上，将 vllm-plugin-FL 的 Iluvatar 分支迁移到新接口，并用隔离依赖和实机门禁验证。\n+\n+### 2.2 官方完整门禁是什么\n+\n+官方工作流定义的完整模型门禁包含：\n+\n+| 维度 | 内容 |\n+|---|---|\n+| 模型 | Qwen3.6-27B、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B |\n+| 执行模式 | eager、graph |\n+| 场景 | `text_single`、`text_concurrent_8`、`image_single`、`image_concurrent_8`、`mixed_concurrent_8` |\n+| 每组请求数 | 1 + 8 + 1 + 8 + 8 = 26 |\n+| 四组总请求 | 2 模型 × 2 模式 × 26 = 104 |\n+| 运行栈 | FlagGems、FlagTree、FlagCX 同时实际生效 |\n+| 判定 | 每个请求检查非空、最小长度、关键词顺序、重复、乱码和控制字符 |\n+\n+小模型冒烟、单元测试、服务 ready、单条请求成功都只能证明对应层级，不能替代这 104 请求门禁。NVIDIA 参考对照又是另一条验证线，不能用自然语言输出相似代替。\n+\n+### 2.3 用户后来调整的范围\n+\n+用户明确要求：35B OCR 输出不稳定先记录，不继续为该问题追加采集、重启大模型或根因定位；继续完成文档、依赖核验和其他适配收尾。因此本文同时保留两件事实：\n+\n+- 原始完整门禁没有全部通过。\n+- 在用户指定范围内，适配、证据整理和已完成的回归已经收尾。\n+\n+---\n+\n+## 3. 环境与版本\n+\n+### 3.1 Iluvatar 目标环境\n+\n+| 项目 | 实际值 |\n+|---|---|\n+| 设备 | Iluvatar BI-V150；完整模型主要使用 TP4、BF16 |\n+| vLLM | 精确 0.32.0，EMPTY 构建；没有依赖 upstream CUDA 扩展 |\n+| Python | 3.12 |\n+| PyTorch | 2.10.0（CoreX 4.5 供应商构建） |\n+| FlagGems | 5.3.5 |\n+| FlagTree | 0.6.2a3+iluvatar3.6 |\n+| Triton | 由已验证的 FlagTree 分发提供 |\n+| FlagCX | `/mnt/share/user_homes/iluv/FlagCX`，commit `6143384`，使用真实 `build/lib/libflagcx.so` |\n+| 插件 | `vllm-plugin-FL` 工作树，HEAD 短哈希 `64c9d21`；测试还包含大量未提交/未跟踪改动 |\n+| 隔离解释器 | `/workspace/envs/iluvatar-vllm032/bin/python` |\n+| vLLM 源码归档 | `/workspace/sources/vllm-0.32.0` |\n+| vLLM 归档 SHA256 | `bf592c132f27bbb5f65cff0bbd2ee873eae722b79c8286934fd5b5cf88b43d61` |\n+| 模型根目录 | `/mnt/share/user_homes/models` |\n+\n+原始全局 vLLM 0.28.0 环境被保留，没有用 0.32 安装覆盖它。启动时需要显式设置仓库 `PYTHONPATH` 和隔离环境 `PATH`，因为继承的 `/usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages` 可能抢先导入另一份 vLLM、FlagGems 或 Triton。\n+\n+### 3.2 旧 0.28 参考与新 0.32 的差别\n+\n+| 项目 | 旧参考 | 本次 0.32 适配 |\n+|---|---|---|\n+| vLLM | 0.28.0+empty | 0.32.0 EMPTY |\n+| PyTorch | 2.10.0+corex.4.5.0 | 同一供应商大版本，但新框架接口不同 |\n+| FlagTree | 旧镜像记录 0.6.0 / Triton 3.6 | 0.6.2a3+iluvatar3.6 |\n+| FlagCX | 历史 PR 明确记录未安装 | 本次实际加载并做 TP/AllReduce 验证 |\n+| graph | PIECEWISE，capture sizes `[1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128,256]` | 收尾 gate 使用 FULL graph、`mode=0`、`custom_ops=all`、关闭 IR wrapping |\n+| 模型上下文 | 旧指南示例最大 32768 | 本次完整门禁主要为 4096 |\n+| 黑名单 | 历史配置为空 | 根据实测故障只排除 zeros/zero_ 和两个视觉 flash 入口 |\n+| runner | 旧版 vendor runner | 迁移 vLLM 0.32 `gpu_model_runner.py` 为独立 Iluvatar runner |\n+| 验证 | 历史通过记录 | 本次增加安装断言、依赖来源断言、组件探针和更严格的请求级 JSON |\n+\n+旧版存在通过记录，但没有证明同一个 OCR 请求在同一依赖和同一硬件条件下长期重复稳定。因此旧版记录可以作为参考，不能作为新版本失败已经归因或已经修复的证明。\n+\n+---\n+\n+## 4. 代码改了什么，以及为什么改\n+\n+工作树没有提交为一个干净 commit，下面按实际文件和功能归类。改动数量不能简单等同于“最终全部正确”，每一项都需要结合对应回归和实机证据理解。\n+\n+### 4.1 独立 Iluvatar ModelRunner\n+\n+文件：`vllm_fl/worker/iluvatar_model_runner.py`\n+\n+这个文件基于 vLLM 0.32.0 的 `vllm/v1/worker/gpu_model_runner.py` 迁移，约 7374 行。与上游版本相比，实际差异包含约 171 行增加、52 行删除，主要包括：\n+\n+- 把 `GPUModelRunner` 变成独立的 `IluvatarModelRunner`，避免直接修改通用 upstream runner。\n+- 将 CUDA 专用的 stream/event 类型换成 `current_platform.torch_device_fn` 提供的抽象。\n+- 对 FlagCX 分布式后端使用设备侧 graph capture 和同步路径。\n+- 使用 `managed_inference_mode()`，让 IO 采集和设备后端的生命周期可以被控制。\n+- 支持 FlagOS/FL 的 IO dump hook 和 step 生命周期。\n+- 让 graph wrapper、FULL graph 清理和 encoder graph 管理与 vLLM 0.32 的 wrapper 类型一致。\n+- 在模型加载前预热 CachedOp，避免 Dynamo/fullgraph tracing 期间进入带锁的懒解析上下文。\n+- 保留 Iluvatar 的 KV cache、视觉输入、采样和异步输出流程。\n+\n+原因是：直接复用旧 runner 会遇到 vLLM 0.32 的导入、类名、上下文、graph 和 worker API 不匹配；直接修改上游 runner 又会让其他厂商共享到 Iluvatar 专用假设。独立 runner 使平台分支隔离。\n+\n+### 4.2 平台选择与 EMPTY 初始化\n+\n+文件：`vllm_fl/__init__.py`、`vllm_fl/platform.py`\n+\n+改动重点：\n+\n+- Iluvatar 注册时强制使用 FL 的 ModelRunner，而不是 vLLM 0.32 的 upstream V2 runner。\n+- 如果 Iluvatar 被配置成 `use_v2_model_runner=True`，直接报错并要求设置 `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=0`。\n+- EMPTY 构建没有 upstream `vllm._C` provider，因此 Iluvatar 默认 IR op priority 使用 `native`，避免引用不存在的 CUDA provider。\n+- 在 OOT 平台显式关闭三个未导入的量化融合 pass：`fuse_norm_quant`、`fuse_act_quant`、`fuse_attn_quant`。\n+- 保留 `fuse_rope_kvcache_cat_mla=False` 的平台护栏，避免编译分区在 OOT 平台启用不存在的融合类。\n+- Iluvatar 初始化时安装 MoE router patch。\n+\n+原因是：Iluvatar 的设备判断不应伪装为 CUDA，也不能让 EMPTY 包通过默认配置调用只在 NVIDIA CUDA 扩展中存在的类。错误配置应该在启动时失败，而不是运行到模型中途才出现难以解释的异常。\n+\n+### 4.3 Worker、PP metadata 和 0.32 API 迁移\n+\n+文件：`vllm_fl/worker/worker.py`\n+\n+改动重点：\n+\n+- `batch_invariant` 从旧路径迁移到 vLLM 0.32 的 `vllm.model_executor.determinism.batch_invariant`。\n+- 移除 0.32 已经删除的 `is_residual_scattered_for_sp` 依赖。\n+- PP worker 使用 0.32 的 `irecv_tensor_dict` / `isend_tensor_dict` 句柄形式，设备发送句柄与 metadata 句柄分开处理。\n+- Iluvatar worker 选择 `IluvatarModelRunner`；其他 vendor 仍走原来的 `ModelRunnerFL`。\n+- 0.32 的 routed-expert 选项不再从旧 `ModelConfig` 字段初始化，避免访问不存在字段。\n+- worker 进程内安装 MoE、vision precision、autotune memory 等 Iluvatar patch。\n+\n+原因是：这些不是算法变更，而是 vLLM 0.32 的接口和生命周期迁移。若继续沿用 0.28 的字段或 metadata 结构，会出现导入失败、PP 收发错配或初始化阶段异常。\n+\n+### 4.4 Graph 生命周期、借用 storage 和显存\n+\n+文件：`vllm_fl/compilation/graph.py`、`vllm_fl/dispatch/backends/vendor/iluvatar/autotune_memory.py`\n+\n+主要改动：\n+\n+- 为 Iluvatar 增加 tensor、list、tuple、dict、`IntermediateTensors` 的递归处理。\n+- 使用 PyTorch storage/data pointer/metadata 重建借用 tensor，保留 shape、stride、dtype、device、offset、conj/neg 属性。\n+- 借用 graph pool 的 storage，但不让输出句柄通过强引用阻止不同 shape 的 graph 复用。\n+- FlagGems autotune 完成后释放 benchmark 参数和 metadata，避免诊断参数长期持有整块 activation。\n+\n+原因是：vLLM 0.32 graph pool 复用时，EMPTY 环境没有可直接使用的 weak-ref tensor primitive。强引用会造成 graph capture 的内存保留和后续 OOM。需要指出的是，借用 storage 只解决生命周期/显存问题，不自动保证 graph replay 的生成正确性。\n+\n+实测中，借用 storage 后 27B 的 graph 捕获不再因显存直接失败，但某次 27B 仍出现长文本重复感叹号，25/26；因此“显存问题修复”和“模型质量全部正确”是两个独立结论。\n+\n+### 4.5 FlagGems 算子分发和 SiLU 编译边界\n+\n+文件：`vllm_fl/dispatch/config/iluvatar.yaml`、`vllm_fl/dispatch/backends/flaggems/impl/activation.py`\n+\n+#### zeros/zero_\n+\n+vLLM 0.32 会分配较大的 KV backing tensor。实测 FlagGems 5.3.5 的 zeros kernel 在 BI-V150 上对约 16 GiB 清零失败；native `zeros` 后续仍可能调用 `zero_`。所以配置同时排除：\n+\n+- `zeros`\n+- `zero_`\n+\n+其余 FlagGems 算子继续开启，避免通过全局关闭 FlagGems 获得表面通过。\n+\n+#### 视觉 flash attention\n+\n+视觉 ViT D72 BF16 场景在 N=256 时使用 FlagGems flash 路径会产生 NaN。native SDPA 还可能重新进入 inner flash 入口，因此同时排除：\n+\n+- `_scaled_dot_product_flash_attention`\n+- `_flash_attention_forward`\n+\n+#### SiLU\n+\n+为 Iluvatar 的 `silu_and_mul` 添加 `torch.library.custom_op` 和 fake shape 推导，把 FlagGems Python dtype inference 隔离在 Dynamo tracing 之外。实际数学计算仍由 FlagGems 执行，目的是让 fullgraph/动态 shape 编译看见稳定的 schema。\n+\n+这些黑名单是有具体故障证据后的局部规避，不是声称相关 kernel 在所有输入上都错误，也不是对 35B OCR 失败的根因定论。\n+\n+### 4.6 FlagCX 通信和视觉精度\n+\n+文件：`vllm_fl/distributed/communicator.py`、`vllm_fl/dispatch/backends/vendor/iluvatar/vision_precision.py`\n+\n+- Iluvatar 如果请求 FlagCX 但初始化失败，直接抛出错误；不允许空库或静默 fallback 被当成通信通过。\n+- 初始化成功时记录 world size 和设备信息。\n+- 视觉 forward 期间，BF16/FP16 的 all-reduce 临时提升为 FP32，再转回原 dtype；decoder 普通归约不无条件改变。\n+- 通过 `ContextVar` 限定 FP32 归约只发生在 Qwen 视觉 forward 上。\n+\n+原因是：视觉 TP 归约的舍入误差会直接影响图像 token；但把所有 decoder 通信改成 FP32 会改变性能和其他路径行为，所以范围必须限定。\n+\n+### 4.7 MoE 路由\n+\n+文件：`vllm_fl/dispatch/backends/vendor/iluvatar/moe_router.py`\n+\n+- 为 0.32 的 fused top-k router 补齐 Iluvatar 缺失的入口。\n+- 无 bias 时调用 FL dispatch 的 `topk_softmax`，兼容“返回新 tensor”和“原地写入”两种后端行为。\n+- 有 expert bias 时，用 bias 影响 expert selection，但返回的权重保持无 bias 的 softmax 分数。\n+- 支持 renormalize、padding mask 和 token expert slot 编号。\n+- 不强行要求 BF16 并列分数时出现特定 expert index 顺序。\n+\n+这部分解决的是 0.32 router schema 和 Iluvatar backend 的语义接缝，组件探针覆盖 n=1/17/256、M=1/6/8/17/128 等有限条件；不能宣称所有真实 MoE 权重和 batch 形状都已穷尽。\n+\n+### 4.8 安装、依赖核验和 CI 门禁\n+\n+文件：\n+\n+- `.github/scripts/iluvatar/install_vllm.sh`\n+- `.github/scripts/iluvatar/setup.sh`\n+- `.github/scripts/iluvatar/verify_stack.py`\n+- `.github/scripts/iluvatar/run_gates.sh`\n+- `.github/workflows/_iluvatar_gate.yml`\n+- `.github/workflows/_platform_test.yml`\n+\n+新增行为：\n+\n+- 下载或接收 vLLM 0.32.0 源码归档后先校验固定 SHA256。\n+- 使用 `VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=empty`、`VLLM_VERSION_OVERRIDE=0.32.0` 和 `--no-build-isolation --no-deps` 安装，避免替换 CoreX torch/FlagTree 栈。\n+- `verify_stack.py` 断言 vLLM、PyTorch、FlagGems、FlagTree 版本和导入路径。\n+- 断言当前插件来自 checkout，当前平台为 Iluvatar，FlagCX 动态库真实可加载，FlagGems 和 plugin 环境变量实际开启。\n+- `run_gates.sh` 串行运行 27B/35B 的 eager/graph 四组，缺模型、缺 FlagCX 或任何请求失败都会返回非零。\n+- GitHub Actions 无论成功失败都上传 JSON 和日志；跳过 gate 不得在聚合通知中伪装成成功。\n+\n+这部分的目的，是把“pip 命令成功”与“运行时导入的就是正确版本”区分开。远端硬件 workflow 已写入配置，但本轮没有在远端 CI runner 上执行。\n+\n+### 4.9 测试文件\n+\n+新增或更新的回归覆盖包括：\n+\n+- runner 选择、Iluvatar runner、PP worker。\n+- graph weak reference、autotune memory、graph memory。\n+- SiLU activation compile、compile passes、compile warmup。\n+- FlagCX、MoE router、vision precision、zeros 配置。\n+- CI setup、CI gate wiring。\n+\n+测试文件证明的是代码结构和局部行为；它们不能替代大模型服务门禁。\n+\n+---\n+\n+## 5. 实际做过什么：时间线\n+\n+以下时刻主要来自日志落盘时间，表示证据写入时间，不冒充精确的进程启动时间。\n+\n+| 时间 | 工作和结果 |\n+|---|---|\n+| 前期 | 建立 vLLM 0.32 EMPTY 隔离环境，迁移 runner、worker、PP metadata、IR 和 FlagCX 路径 |\n+| 12:31:55 | Qwen3-4B TP1 eager 真实生成 16 tokens |\n+| 约 12:59 | Qwen3-4B TP2 graph 生成两条 16-token 输出；退出时存在 worker/shared_memory 清理警告，未隐藏 |\n+| 13:48:34 | 27B eager v3 完成五场景、26/26 |\n+| 13:49:44 | 独立 venv 安装和导入精确 vLLM 0.32.0 |\n+| 中期 | 修复 zeros、视觉 flash NaN、MoE router、graph storage、autotune memory、SiLU 编译边界 |\n+| 16:29:51 | 35B eager v4 完成 26/26；随后重复测试仍发现 OCR 波动 |\n+| 17:42:10 | 27B borrowed-storage graph 不再直接 OOM，但出现 25/26 |\n+| 18:41:56 / 18:43:52 | 35B/27B FULL graph、compilation NONE 对照各曾有 26/26 |\n+| 20:27:49 | 27B graph recheck 26/26 |\n+| 20:28:25 / 20:28:52 | 35B graph/eager recheck 各 25/26，均为同一 OCR 失败 |\n+| 后期 | 做交替请求、logprob、采集开关、首层/全 rank、通信和组件重复性诊断；没有定位根因 |\n+| 21:55:08 | 最终同步记录落盘 48 次请求，四阶段失败数 4/2/2/2 |\n+| 21:59:57 | 相关最终回归 157 passed、1 warning、16.53 秒 |\n+| 2026-11-02 | 只读整理文档；按用户要求不再启动 OCR 或大模型实验 |\n+\n+---\n+\n+## 6. 测试结果和证据分层\n+\n+### 6.1 小模型 Qwen3-4B\n+\n+已做：\n+\n+- TP1 eager 文本生成。\n+- TP1 graph 文本生成。\n+- TP2 FlagCX eager 文本生成。\n+- TP2 FlagCX graph 文本生成。\n+- 每次保存输出 JSON 或日志。\n+\n+结论：能证明指定小模型、指定 TP、指定执行模式可以完成文本生成；不能证明图片能力，因为 Qwen3-4B 本身是文本模型；不能证明 27B/35B 完整门禁；不能证明 NVIDIA token 级一致。\n+\n+### 6.2 完整门禁请求定义\n+\n+每组 26 请求包含：\n+\n+- `text_single`：一条 256 字符以上的 LLM 介绍，检查关键词和重复。\n+- `text_concurrent_8`：8 条简单问答，检查答案词和顺序。\n+- `image_single`：单张含文字图片，重点是 `image-05` 的 `hello vllm`。\n+- `image_concurrent_8`：8 张图并发，image-05 使用“是否含可见文字”的变体请求。\n+- `mixed_concurrent_8`：4 条文本和 4 条图片混合并发。\n+\n+质量检查不只是 HTTP 200，还包括：非空、最小长度、关键词顺序、乱码、控制字符、三连感叹号、重复词、重复短语。\n+\n+### 6.3 最新可比结果\n+\n+| 模型 | 模式 | 最新可用结果 | 失败内容 |\n+|---|---|---:|---|\n+| Qwen3.6-27B | graph/FULL、compilation NONE | 26/26 | 无 |\n+| Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | eager | 25/26 | `image-05` 输出 `HELLO VLM` |\n+| Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | graph/FULL、compilation NONE | 25/26 | `image-05` 输出 `HELLO VLM` |\n+\n+27B eager 的 26/26 是历史有效记录，但本轮最新三组复测没有重跑它。因此不能把表格拼成 4 组最新 102/104，更不能写成 104/104。\n+\n+### 6.4 历史对照实验如何解释\n+\n+| 实验 | 结果 | 能说明什么 |\n+|---|---:|---|\n+| graph 默认显存预算 0.92 | 捕获 OOM | 默认预算不适合当前模型/图形状 |\n+| graph 显存预算 0.70 | 仍有形状/自调优 OOM | 仅降低预算不能解决所有 graph 内存问题 |\n+| borrowed storage | 捕获更稳定；27B 曾 25/26，35B 曾 21/26 | 解决部分 graph storage 生命周期，不等于质量通过 |\n+| 35B PIECEWISE | 23/26 | 图分段仍有生成错误 |\n+| 35B compile-only | 22/26 | 错误不能只归因于 graph capture/replay |\n+| custom_ops=all、关闭 IR wrapping | 27B 25/26、35B 22/26 | 编译边界改动有影响但未完全通过 |\n+| FULL、compilation NONE | 两模型曾各 26/26 | 该次配置可工作，不证明重复稳定 |\n+| 后续 35B eager/graph 复测 | 各 25/26 | 历史单次通过不能覆盖后续失败 |\n+\n+收尾 gate 选择 FULL、compilation NONE，是因为当前 Inductor/混合 PIECEWISE 路径仍有生成正确性问题。这样做是为了得到可解释的 graph replay 对照，不是宣称 Inductor 已修复。\n+\n+### 6.5 组件和通信证据\n+\n+已保留的组件证据包括：\n+\n+- FlagCX TP2/TP4 AllReduce 探针，固定输入下逐位一致。\n+- MoE router n=1/17/256 以及固定输入重复测试。\n+- SiLU dynamic fullgraph、逐位比较和 opcheck。\n+- graph pool allocated 增量小于 1 MiB 的探针。\n+- GDN 固定长度、不同分配历史下的重复性探针。\n+- 视觉归约 FP32 相关探针。\n+\n+这些结果只能约束所测组件和形状，不能排除真实模型中所有状态交互，也不能从组件通过推导出 35B OCR 根因。\n+\n+### 6.6 单元回归和安装核验\n+\n+- 最终相关回归：`iluvatar-regression032-final.log`，157 passed、1 warning、16.53 秒。\n+- 依赖核验：`verify-stack032-final.log`，确认 vLLM 0.32.0、插件路径、FlagGems、FlagTree、PyTorch 和真实 FlagCX 库。\n+- shell 语法检查、`git diff --check` 和 CI wiring 检查已完成。\n+- 远端真实硬件 CI workflow 未执行。\n+\n+---\n+\n+## 7. 35B OCR 问题：现象、排查和边界\n+\n+### 7.1 现象\n+\n+请求 `image-05` 要求读取图片中的 `hello vllm`。相同服务和相同请求曾出现：\n+\n+- 正确：`HELLO VLLM`\n+- 错误：`HELLO VLM`\n+- 错误：`HELLO VLIM`\n+\n+错误在 eager 和 FULL Graph 都出现过。最新两组 35B 复测都是 `HELLO VLM`，因此不能把早期一次 26/26 当成稳定修复。\n+\n+### 7.2 已做的诊断\n+\n+排查曾覆盖：\n+\n+- eager 与 graph 对照。\n+- compilation NONE、PIECEWISE、compile-only 和 custom_ops 组合。\n+- 采集开关的关闭/开启/关闭阶段。\n+- 服务端交替请求和重复请求。\n+- 首个分歧 token 的 top-k/logprob。\n+- prefill 最后 token、首个 decode、首层和部分全 rank 采集。\n+- FlagCX、MoE、GDN、投影、复制和同步探针。\n+- 原生 PyTorch 与 FlagGems 的独立重复计算。\n+\n+部分观察：同一前缀的首个 decode 已出现差异；某些候选 logprob 接近，但另一些分歧并非简单平局；最终 48 次同步记录四阶段失败数为 4/2/2/2。上述都是定位线索，不是根因证明。\n+\n+### 7.3 不能写成什么\n+\n+目前不能写成：\n+\n+- NVIDIA 原生对照\n+\n+### 8.1 做了什么\n+\n+曾使用远程租用的 **NVIDIA A800-SXM4-80GB** 作为参考机器，不是 A100，也不是当前 BI-V150 容器。参考端使用：\n+\n+- 原生 vLLM 0.32.0，无 FL 插件。\n+- PyTorch 2.13.0+cu130。\n+- Transformers 5.19.0。\n+- Qwen3-4B 非量化模型。\n+- TP1、BF16、eager、seed 0、temperature 0、top_p 1、max_tokens 32。\n+- max model length / max batched tokens 512，max seqs 1，GPU memory utilization 0.65，关闭 prefix cache。\n+- 相同 chat 条请求结果：\n+\n+| 请求 | 结果 |\n+|---|---|\n+| Paris is the capital of | 完全一致 |\n+| The quick brown fox jumps over the | 首 token 分歧 |\n+| In machine learning, a transformer model | 完全一致 |\n+| Once upon a 38.8889%，`all_exact=false`。\n+\n+### 8.3 如何解释\n+\n+这是**自由生成**比较。第一个 token 分歧后，两个端的上下文已经不同，后续 token 的位置比较不再是同一条件下的数值比较。因此它能说明“在当前条件下输出发生了明显差异”，不能单凭它定位某个算子或宣称 teacher-forced ### codex-l1808 · 2026-11-02T12:19:20.829Z

````javascript
text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch\n*** Update File: flagscale-agent-monitor/详细适配交接报告.md\n@@\n 本文是阶段交接文档，不是“所有测试通过”或“适配可以直接发布”的声明。\n+\n+---\n+\n+## 13. 逐场景结果矩阵与测试判据\n+\n+### 13.1 原始 JSON 再核对结果\n+\n+下表由本次整理时实际读取磁盘场景 JSON 核对。分母是请求数，不是 pytest 用例数。\n+\n+| 场景 | 27B eager：历史 `final` | 27B FULL graph：`recheck-v10` | 35B eager：`reproduce-v3` | 35B FULL graph：`recheck-v10` |\n+|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|\n+| text_single | 1/1 | 1/1 | 1/1 | 1/1 |\n+| text_concurrent_8 | 8/8 | 8/8 | 8/8 | 8/8 |\n+| image_single | 1/1 | 1/1 | **0/1** | **0/1** |\n+| image_concurrent_8 | 8/8 | 8/8 | 8/8 | 8/8 |\n+| mixed_concurrent_8 | 8/8 | 8/8 | 8/8 | 8/8 |\n+| 本列有效结果 | 26/26 | 26/26 | **25/26** | **25/26** |\n+| 场景通过 | 5/5 | 5/5 | **4/5** | **4/5** |\n+| 时间口径 | 较早单轮结果 | 最近三组复测之一 | 最近三组复测之一 | 最近三组复测之一 |\n+\n+后三列合计：15 场景通过 13 个，78 请求通过 76 个。左侧历史列单独保留，不加入“同一轮完整矩阵”的统计。\n+\n+35B 的两个失败 JSON 中，原始输出实际为 `HELLO\\nVLM`。`non_empty`、`minimum_length` 等检查仍然为 True，失败的是 `expected_semantics` 和 `expected_order`。这说明服务确实生成了文本，但没有识别出完整的第二个单词，不能以“非空”或“基本能读图”替代请求质量通过。\n+\n+### 13.2 同一张图在两个场景中的问题不同\n+\n+这一点对理解测试结果很重要：\n+\n+| 场景 | image-05 的问题 | 原始要求 |\n+|---|---|---|\n+| image_single | 读取两个单词，第二词四个字母，逐字抄写 | 按顺序包含 `hello`、`vllm` |\n+| image_concurrent_8 | 图片是否有可见文字，只回答 yes/no | 包含 `yes` |\n+\n+因此 `image_concurrent_8` 的 8/8 并不证明精确 OCR 在并发下正常。它证明的是该场景定义的八个请求通过，其中 image-05 只验证是否存在文字。本文按现有库存报告，没有在文档阶段修改问题、图片或判据。\n+\n+### 13.3 语义门禁和数值精度的差别\n+\n+语义门禁检查是否回答了任务要求，例如算术等于 42、颜色顺序正确、能读出 `hello vllm`。只要满足原始检查，允许回答格式和部分措辞差异。\n+\n+NVIDIA token 对照检查的是同一输入下 token 序列是否完全一致；即使两段话意思都合理，也可能严格失败。teacher-forced 则进一步要求两端每一步使用相同历史前缀，比较同条件分布或 logits。三类验证的问题不同：\n+\n+| 验证 | 当前状态 | 可以回答的问题 |\n+|---|---|---|\n+| 小模型生成冒烟 | 有通过证据 | 此环境能否加载并完成指定文本生成？ |\n+| 原始图文服务门禁 | 有通过也有失败 | 给定服务配置是否满足仓库质量用例？ |\n+| 自由生成 token 对照 | 已完成，严格失败 | 当前两端最终生成轨迹是否完全一致？ |\n+| teacher-forced/逐层定位 | 未执行 | 相同前缀的数值差从哪一步、哪一层开始？ |\n+\n+---\n+\n+## 14. Eager、Graph、编译与 EMPTY 的具体区别\n+\n+### 14.1 EMPTY 为什么不等于没有计算\n+\n+EMPTY 指 vLLM 不构建上游特定 CUDA 原生扩展，不是模型在 CPU 上空跑。实际计算仍由 CoreX PyTorch、FlagTree/Triton、FlagGems、厂商算子和 FL dispatch 完成；通信由真实 FlagCX 等路径承接。\n+\n+所以日志中出现 `No module named 'vllm._C'` 时，需要结合后续路径判断：EMPTY 环境缺少该模块本身符合构建方式；但如果后续无条件调用 `_C`、引用不存在的 `vllm_c` provider 或启动依赖它的 runner，就是需要适配的错误。\n+\n+### 14.2 三个维度不能混为一个开关\n+\n+| 配置 | 含义 | 当前证据 |\n+|---|---|---|\n+| eager / `--enforce-eager` | 不使用服务 graph 捕获/replay 路径 | 小模型和大模型均有实机证据，35B OCR 仍可失败 |\n+| FULL CUDA Graph | 捕获完整执行并 replay，降低重复调度开销 | 当前收尾配置保留此路径；没有性能测量支撑加速幅度 |\n+| PIECEWISE / 混合 graph | 按边界拆分并捕获/执行 | 曾出现错误生成，未验收 |\n+| compilation NONE / `mode=0` | 不执行该层面的 Inductor 编译 | 与 FULL graph 可以同时存在 |\n+| Inductor 编译 | 对模型图进行追踪、优化和 lowering | 有编译边界修复，但完整生成正确性仍未通过 |\n+\n+当前配置为：\n+\n+```json\n+{\n+  \"mode\": 0,\n+  \"cudagraph_mode\": \"FULL\",\n+  \"custom_ops\": [\"all\"],\n+  \"ir_enable_torch_wrap\": false\n+}\n+```\n+\n+它保留 FULL graph replay，同时绕开当前未通过的编译路径。因此既不能把它写成“关闭 graph 的 eager”，也不能写成“完整 Inductor 编译适配已通过”。\n+\n+### 14.3 显存参数为什么改成 0.70\n+\n+通用 `run_serve_eager.sh` 和 `run_serve_graph.sh` 的默认显存比例仍是 0.92；本次 Iluvatar gate helper 显式设置为 0.70。两者作用层级不同，不是代码和报告互相矛盾。\n+\n+较低预算给模型之外的 graph capture、workspace、自调优和运行时保留更多空间。它不等于可用物理显存变小，也不保证所有形状都不 OOM。实验保持 TP4、4096 等参数后继续出现 OOM，促使进一步检查 autotuner 和 graph storage 生命周期。\n+\n+---\n+\n+## 15. 问题清单、处理状态和判断依据\n+\n+| 编号 | 具体问题 | 已做处理/观察 | 当前状态 |\n+|---|---|---|---|\n+| I-01 | 继承 PYTHONPATH 抢先导入全局旧 vLLM | 安装时清理，启动/CI 固定 checkout 和解释器，打印模块路径 | 本地核验通过；新机器仍需重新断言 |\n+| I-02 | `batch_invariant` 导入路径变化 | 改为 0.32 determinism 路径 | 本地导入和回归通过 |\n+| I-03 | 旧 ModelConfig routed-expert 字段消失 | 按 0.32 runner 生命周期处理 | 启动障碍已解除 |\n+| I-04 | V2 runner 依赖不支持的 CUDA/UVA | 默认选 FL/V1，显式 V2 拒绝 | 有选择隔离回归 |\n+| I-05 | EMPTY 没有 CUDA IR provider | Iluvatar 使用 native priority | 本地初始化和生成有证据 |\n+| I-06 | 大块 FlagGems zeros/zero_ 清零失败 | 局部黑名单排除两个入口 | 在已测 KV cache/TP 路径解除障碍 |\n+| I-07 | 视觉 flash 路径 NaN | 同时排除外层和 inner flash 入口 | 已测视觉路径可继续执行 |\n+| I-08 | router padding/bias/schema 不匹配 | 补齐 Iluvatar MoE router | 组件与生成有证据；非全形状穷尽 |\n+| I-09 | graph pool 输出强引用保留内存 | borrowed storage、视图元数据和共享池回归 | 对应探针通过，部分捕获 OOM 解除 |\n+| I-10 | autotune 诊断参数长期持有 activation | 结束后释放 benchmark 参数 | 探针有效，单独不足以解决模型问题 |\n+| I-11 | Dynamo 追踪 CachedOp 的锁或 Python dtype 推断 | 提前预热、SiLU custom op/fake | 编译入口问题有修复，整体编译仍未验收 |\n+| I-12 | OOT 引用未导入的融合 pass | 显式禁用对应融合 | 启动/预热问题有修复 |\n+| I-13 | PIECEWISE/Inductor 错误生成 | 做 compile-only、graph 和 custom-op 对照 | **未解决**，当前 gate 用 FULL + NONE |\n+| I-14 | 35B OCR 同服务输出不稳定 | 保存 logprob、组件和 48 请求同步证据 | **未解决，按用户要求停止排查** |\n+| I-15 | NVIDIA 小模型严格输出不一致 | 完成真实原生参考、同文件校验和逐请求比较 | **严格失败，未做逐层定位** |\n+| I-16 | TP2 graph 退出有 worker/shared_memory 警告 | 保留原日志，没有抹去或声称清理无告警 | 后续退出生命周期仍可单独核查 |\n+| I-17 | + FL | 版本相同，后端不同 |\n+| PyTorch | 2.13.0+cu130 | 2.10.0 | 不同 |\n+| Transformers | 5.19.0 | 5.14.1 | 不同 |\n+| dtype/TP | BF16 / 1 | BF16 / 1 | 一致 |\n+| graph | eager | eager | 一致 |\n+| engine 参数 | 512/512、max seqs 1、显存 .65、prefix cache off | 同样参数 | 比较器实际断言一致 |\n+| 采样 | seed 0、temperature 0、top_p 1、max tokens 32 | 同样参数 | 比较器实际断言一致 |\n+| prompt | 同 chat template，thinking off | 同文本与 token IDs | 比较器实际断言一致 |\n+| 插件 | 空字符串，未加载 FL | `fl` | 按对照目的不同 |\n+\n+### 16.2 每条请求长度和首差\n+\n+索引从 0 开始；没有分歧记为“无”。\n+\n+| 索引 | 简述 | 参考/目标输出长度 | 首差 | 相同位置数 |\n+|---|---|---:|---:|---:|\n+| 0 | Paris | 10/10 | 无 | 10/10 |\n+| 1 | quick brown fox | 32/32 | 0 | 0/32 |\n+| 2 | transformer model | 32/32 | 无 | 32/32 |\n+| 3 | fairy tale | 32/32 | 0 | 0/32 |\n+| 4 | speed of light | 32/32 | 8 | 8/32 |\n+| 5 | 17 + 25 | 3/3 | 无 | 3/3 |\n+| 6 | hello → French | 3/3 | 无 | 3/3 |\n+\n+例如故事请求，参考直接续写 `Once upon a time ...`，目标以 `*leans in ...*` 的对话式回答开头。两者都能生成语言，但轨迹不同；它们不能被算成严格精度对齐通过。两条短请求中的 EOS token 也进入了序列长度统计。\n+\n+### 16.3 首差不是都能解释成极小平局\n+\n+只在分歧前历史仍一致的第一个位置比较候选，观察为：\n+\n+| 请求索引/位置 | 参考 top1 ID | 目标 top1 ID | 参考 top1-top2 logprob 差 | 目标 top1-top2 差 |\n+|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|\n+| 1 / 0 | 785 | 2132 | 约 6.25 | 约 5.125 |\n+| 3 / 0 | 12522 | 9 | 约 6.25 | 0.625 |\n+| 4 / 8 | 13187 | 264 | 约 5.00 | 0.500 |\n+\n+这些数值来自保存的原始输出 top-5 logprob，支持“需要继续定位差异”的判断，不支持把全部首差简单归因为微小舍入下的平局。它们仍不足以认定硬件、插件或某个算子有错，因为 PyTorch/Transformers 和执行后端没有完全控制为同一条件。\n+\n+### 16.4 比较器做了哪些保护\n+\n+`compare.py` 会检查两端：\n+\n+- vLLM 版本、engine 字典、sampling 字典一致。\n+- 请求数、问题、完整 prompt 文本和输入 token IDs 一致。\n+- 比较全部 token 序列，分母取两端最大长度，避免只比较公共前缀漏掉截断。\n+- 记录 finish reason 是否一致，以及首个分歧位置。\n+- `all_exact` 同时要求 token 序列和 finish reason 一致。\n+\n+历史负向测试曾验证：目标尾部截断会降低通过数；输入 token 篡改会触发断言。命令退出 0 只说明比较程序执行成功，不说明数据通过；必须读取 `all_exact=false`。\n+\n+### 16.5 为什么花费时间，以及现在还剩什么\n+\n+远端环境当时需要传输 Qwen3-4B 文件并安装原生 vLLM/PyTorch/CUDA 依赖。日志记录下载速率曾低至约 0.2–1 MB/s；后来切换 uv 并复用校验过的完整 wheel。等待安装不是模型测试仍在计算，不能把安装时间算成推理性能。\n+\n+结果下载曾遇到本地空文件被误当成“结果已就绪”的风险，后续改为：确认远端非空、下载 `.partial`、校验大小与 JSON 后原子替换。本轮最终文件已再次实际解析核对。远端环境已经删除，文档阶段没有重新安装它。\n+\n+---\n+\n+## 17. 相关回归到底覆盖了什么\n+\n+以下列表来自最终 157 `test_iluvatar_flagcx.py` | 2 | Iluvatar FlagCX 初始化约束 |\n+| `test_iluvatar_gate_ci.py` | 3 | CI gate 配置和失败传播 |\n+| `test_iluvatar_moe_router.py` | 5 | bias、padding、renormalize 等 router 语义 |\n+| `test_iluvatar_runner032.py` | 5 | runner 导入和多 vendor 选择隔离 |\n+| `test_iluvatar_vision_precision.py` | 9 | 视觉上下文与归约 dtype 范围 |\n+| `test_iluvatar_zeros_config.py` | 1 | zeros/zero_ 黑名单 |\n+| 不变、递归容器、view stride/offset、negative view、释放生命周期、更新输入后 replay、多个 capture 共享池，以及缺失 PyTorch primitive 时明确失败。部分 runner/CI 契约测试使用 mock/AST 提取分支，不能把这部分通过称为其他厂商硬件已经运行通过。\n+\n+该次唯一 warning 是 active Triton  count += summary[\"request_count\"]\n+        passed += summary[\"passed_count\"]\n+    assert scenarios == 5\n+    assert count == 26\n+    print(group, passed, count)\n+```\n+\n+期望输出分别为 text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python - <<'PY'\nfrom pathlib import Path\np=Path('/workspace/flagscale-agent-monitor/flagscale-agent反复停止修复记录-20261103.md')\np.write_text('''# flagscale-agent 反复停止排查与修复记录\n\n日期：2026-11-03（北京时间）。会话：`4761e787`。任务：PR #674 的 CI 失败诊断。\n\n## 故障表现与直接证据\n\n原 flagscale-agent 进程仍然存在，但没有执行中的子任务；用户多次输入“继续”后，保存的历史仅增加用户消息，没有新的助手回复。\n\n在可观察的 tmux 终端恢复同一会话后，复现 HTTP 400：\n\n```text\nInvalid …create payload: Missing required parameter: 'input[200].output[0].type'.\n```\n\n这是 LLM 请求被接口拒绝后，本轮执行返回交互提示符；本次复现没有发生容器退出或 Python 进程崩溃。内核捕获异常后仅在终端显示错误，未将该错误作为助手消息写入对话历史，因此仅看保存的对话容易误判为无故停止。本结论解释本次复现，不能据此断言历史上每一次停止均为同一原因。\n\n## 原因\n\n1. 历史消息里有一条 GitHub CI annotations 的工具结果，是一个含 6 条注释的列表。\n2. `HistoryManager.recall_message()` 会把以 `[` 或 `{` 开头的 JSON 文本反序列化为列表或字典。\n3. OpenAI provider 直接把工具结果放入 Responses 的 `function_call_output.output`。\n4. Responses 把这个列表按接口内容块解析，要求每个元素具有 `type`；GitHub annotation 只有 path、message、annotation_level 等业务字段，因此缺少 type，返回 400。\n5. 反复输入“继续”仍会重新发送同一条不合法的历史数据，无法消除故障。\n\n## 本地修复\n\n源码目录：`/workspace/flagscale-agent-migration/FlagScale-Agent`。\n\n修改：`flagscale_agent/react/providers/openai_provider.py`。\n\n- 新增 `_tool_output_text()`：字符串保持原样，None 转为空字符串，其他 JSON 数据序列化为文本。\n- Responses 的工具输出通过此方法转换；Chat Completions 的工具消息也执行相同转换。\n- 转换只发生在 API 请求边界，不改写保存的历史内容；保留 0、False、空列表和空字典的值。\n- 普通用户消息中的图像等有类型内容块不受这一工具输出转换影响。\n\n回归测试：`tests/test_openai_responses.py`，新增 16 个参数化用例，覆盖两个协议，以及 GitHub annotations、字典、空列表、空字典、0、False、None 和字符串；断言真实 SDK 发出的 HTTP 请求格式与原始历史保持不变。\n\n## 验证\n\n```bash\npython -m pytest -q tests/test_openai_responses.py\n# 39 passed in 3.03s\npython -m pytest -q tests/test_kernel.py tests/test_context_pressure_recovery.py tests/test_empty_retry_thinking_fix.py\n# 30 passed in 0.38s\n```\n\n另以实际保存的会话构建请求，69 条工具结果全部为字符串；GitHub annotations 数据仍完整保留为 JSON 文本。\n\n## 恢复措施\n\n- 对原会话 conversation.json / conversation_full.json 及修改前源码建立备份，位置：`/root/.flagscale/recovery-backups/4761e787-20261103-113600/`。其中会话含敏感信息，备份目录和文件设置了限制访问权限，不应公开上传。\n- 结束原先空闲的进程，释放会话锁；恢复同一个会话到 tmux `flagscale-agent`，避免同时运行两个进程写同一份历史。\n- 修复后执行 `/reload`，终端确认恢复 `4761e787`（43 turns，162 messages），再提交继续诊断指令。\n- 指令限定：保存现有计划，必要时清理上下文，继续 CodeQL 控制流探针及 H20 Checkout 失败分析；不重跑模型/OCR、不自动 push 或合并。\n\n进入恢复终端：\n\n```bash\ntmux attach -t flagscale-agent\n```\n\n退出终端连接但保留运行：依次按 `Ctrl+b`、`d`。\n\n## 恢复后实际运行情况\n\n待核验本次真实 LLM 请求与后续工具执行后补充。\n''',encoding='utf-8')\nprint(p)\nPY","max_output_tokens":500}));
````

```python
import json
from pathlib import Path
import torch
root = Path('/workspace/adapt-logs')
a = torch.load(root / 'layer-trace-eager.pt', weights_only=True)
b = torch.load(root / 'layer-trace-graph.pt', weights_only=True)
pa = json.loads((root / 'layer-trace-eager.json').read_text())[0]
pb = json.loads((root / 'layer-trace-graph.json').read_text())[0]
assert pa['prompt_token_ids'] == pb['prompt_token_ids'], 'different prompt tokens'
assert len(a) == len(b) and len(a) > 0, 'missing layers'
common = 0
for x, y in zip(pa['tokens'], pb['tokens']):
    if x != y:
        break
    common += 1
print('OUTPUTS', repr(pa['text']), repr(pb['text']), 'common_tokens', common)
rows = []
for key in a:
    x, y = a[key], b[key]
    count = min(x['count'], y['count'], common + 1, 16)
    assert count > 0 and len(x['values']) == len(y['values'])
    for stream, (left, right) in enumerate(zip(x['values'], y['values'])):
        for step in range(count):
            delta = (left[step].float() - right[step].float()).abs()
            row = dict(layer=int(key), stream=stream, step=step,
                equal=torch.equal(left[step], right[step]),
                max_abs=delta.max().item(), mean_abs=delta.mean().item(),
                relative_l2=(delta.norm() / left[step].float().norm().clamp_min(1e-12)).item())
            rows.append(row)
            print(json.dumps(row))
(root / 'layer-trace-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2))

```

### 当前文件：`/workspace/adapt-logs/compare_prefix_diagnostic.py`

```python
import itertools
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import torch

records = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
results = []
for left, right in itertools.combinations(records, 2):
    first = left['response']['choices'][0]
    second = right['response']['choices'][0]
    tokens_left = first['logprobs']['content']
    tokens_right = second['logprobs']['content']
    shared = 0
    for token_left, token_right in zip(tokens_left, tokens_right):
        if token_left['bytes'] != token_right['bytes']:
            break
        shared += 1
    trace_left = torch.load(left['trace'], map_location='cpu', weights_only=True)
    trace_right = torch.load(right['trace'], map_location='cpu', weights_only=True)
    differences = []
    for key in trace_left:
        if key not in trace_right:
            continue
        for tensor_index, (value_left, value_right) in enumerate(zip(trace_left[key]['values'], trace_right[key]['values'])):
            rows = min(shared + 1, value_left.shape[0], value_right.shape[0])
            delta = (value_left[:rows].float() - value_right[:rows].float()).abs()
            for row in range(rows):
                maximum = delta[row].max().item()
                if maximum:
                    differences.append({'key': key, 'tensor': tensor_index, 'row': row, 'max_abs': maximum})
                    break
    results.append({'left': left['trial'], 'right': right['trial'], 'shared_tokens': shared, 'text_left': first['message']['content'], 'text_right': second['message']['content'], 'first_token_disagreement': [tokens_left[shared], tokens_right[shared]] if shared < min(len(tokens_left), len(tokens_right)) else None, 'matching_prefix_tensor_differences': differences})
output = Path(sys.argv[2])
output.write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
print('PAIRS', len(results), 'OUTPUT_VARIANTS', len({record['response']['choices'][0]['message']['content'] for record in records}))
for result in results:
    print(result['left'], result['right'], 'shared', result['shared_tokens'], 'different_tensors', len(result['matching_prefix_tensor_differences']), 'token_disagreement', bool(result['first_token_disagreement']))

```

```python
"""Report earliest differing layer/stream for equal-prefix serving traces."""
import json
from itertools import combinations
from pathlib import Path
import torch
import sys
root = Path('/workspace/adapt-logs')
label = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'serving-trace032'
records = json.loads((root/f'{label}.json').read_text())
traced = [r for r in records if 'trace' in r]
rows = []
for left, right in combinations(traced, 2):
    a = torch.load(left['trace'], weights_only=True)
    b = torch.load(right['trace'], weights_only=True)
    assert set(a) == set(b) and a
    first = None
    count = min(min(entry['count'] for entry in a.values()), min(entry['count'] for entry in b.values()))
    for step in range(count):
        for key in a:
            for stream, (x, y) in enumerate(zip(a[key]['values'], b[key]['values'])):
                delta = (x[step].float()-y[step].float()).abs()
                if delta.any() and first is None:
                    first = dict(step=step, layer=key, stream=stream, max_abs=delta.max().item(), changed=(delta>0).sum().item())
    row = dict(left=left['index'], right=right['index'], left_text=left['response']['choices'][0]['message']['content'], right_text=right['response']['choices'][0]['message']['content'], first_difference=first)
    rows.append(row)
    print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
(root/f'{label}-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))

```

### 当前文件：`/workspace/adapt-logs/compare_sync_trace032.py`

```python
"""Compare matched first decode steps on every TP rank, within trace modes."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import torch
root=Path('/workspace/adapt-logs')
import sys
label = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'sync-trace032'
records=json.loads((root/f'{label}.json').read_text())
results=[]
for mode in (True,'sync'):
    group=[r for r in records if r['traced']==mode and 'trace' in r]
    if not group: continue
    reference=group[0]
    for rank in range(4):
        def load(record):
            path=Path(record['trace'])
            if rank: path=path.with_suffix(f'.rank{rank}.pt')
            return torch.load(path,weights_only=True)
        a=load(reference)
        assert a
        for record in group[1:]:
            b=load(record)
            assert set(a)==set(b)
            first=None
            for step in (0,1):
                for key in a:
                    for stream,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a[key]['values'],b[key]['values'])):
                        assert x.shape[0]>step and y.shape[0]>step
                        delta=(x[step].float()-y[step].float()).abs()
                        if delta.any() and first is None:
                            first=dict(step=step,key=key,stream=stream,max_abs=delta.max().item(),changed=(delta>0).sum().item())
            row=dict(mode=mode,rank=rank,left=reference['index'],right=record['index'],left_text=reference['response']['choices'][0]['message']['content'],right_text=record['response']['choices'][0]['message']['content'],first=first)
            results.append(row)
            print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
(root/f'{label}-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2))

```

```python
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import torch
root = Path('/workspace/adapt-logs')
label = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'component-trace032'
left, right = (int(v) for v in sys.argv[2:4]) if len(sys.argv)>3 else (6,7)
a = torch.load(root/f'{label}-{left}.pt',weights_only=True)
b = torch.load(root/f'{label}-{right}.pt',weights_only=True)
for key in a:
    if key.startswith('layer.'):
        continue
    for stream,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a[key]['values'],b[key]['values'])):
        for step in (0,1):
            delta=(x[step].float()-y[step].float()).abs()
            indices=(delta>0).nonzero().flatten()
            print(key,'stream',stream,'step',step,'shape',list(x.shape),'max',delta.max().item(),'changed',len(indices),'indices',indices[:30].tolist(),flush=True)
```

```python
def _accelerator_synchronize() -> None:
    """Synchronize through the active accelerator implementation."""
    if current_platform.device_type == "musa":
        import torch_musa

        torch_musa.synchronize()

@contextmanager
def _device_graph_capture(
    device: torch.device,
    graph_capture_context: GraphCaptureContext | None = None,
):
    """Enter graph capture using the active accelerator's stream API."""
    if graph_capture_context is None:
        graph_capture_context = GraphCaptureContext(
            current_platform.torch_device_fn.Stream(device=device)
        )
    stream = graph_capture_context.stream
    curr_stream = current_platform.torch_device_fn.current_stream()
    if curr_stream != stream:
        stream.wait_stream(curr_stream)
    with current_platform.torch_device_fn.stream(stream), nullcontext():
        yield graph_capture_context

def _get_parameter_for_reload(model: nn.Module, name: str) -> nn.Parameter:
    """Resolve checkpoint names without changing the model's module tree."""
    module_name, _, parameter_name = name.rpartition(".")
    module = model.get_submodule(module_name)
    if isinstance(module, BaseLayerWithLoRA):
        module = module.base_layer
    return module.get_parameter(parameter_name)

def count_nans_per_row(logits: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Per-row NaN counts, left on device."""
    return logits.isnan().sum(dim=-1, dtype=torch.int32)


def nans_to_dict(counts: list[int], req_id_to_index: dict[str, int]) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Map per-row NaN counts onto request ids.

    Rows and requests need not correspond one-to-one, so requests without a
    row are reported as 0.
    """
    return {
        req_id: int(counts[i]) if i < len(counts) else 0
        for req_id, i in req_id_to_index.items()
    }


# Wrapper for ModelRunnerOutput to support overlapped execution.
class AsyncGPUModelRunnerOutput(AsyncModelRunnerOutput):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_runner_output: ModelRunnerOutput,
        sampled_token_ids: torch.Tensor,
        logprobs_tensors: LogprobsTensors | None,
        invalid_req_indices: list[int],
        async_output_copy_stream: current_platform.torch_device_fn.Stream,
        vocab_size: int,
        check_ep_fault: bool = False,
        num_nans: torch.Tensor | None = None,
    ):
        self._model_runner_output = model_runner_output
        self._invalid_req_indices = invalid_req_indices

        # Event on the copy stream so we can synchronize the non-blocking copy.
        # Blocking (sleep) event to avoid busy-polling the CUDA driver lock.
        self.async_copy_ready_event = current_platform.torch_device_fn.Event(
            blocking=True
        )

        # Keep a reference to the device tensor to avoid it being
        # deallocated until we finish copying it to the host.
        self._sampled_token_ids = sampled_token_ids
        self.vocab_size = vocab_size
        self._logprobs_tensors = logprobs_tensors
        self._num_nans = num_nans
        self._has_fault: torch.Tensor | None = None

        # Initiate the copy on a separate stream, but do not synchronize it.
        default_stream = current_platform.torch_device_fn.current_stream()
        with current_platform.torch_device_fn.stream(async_output_copy_stream):
            async_output_copy_stream.wait_stream(default_stream)
            self.sampled_token_ids_cpu = self._sampled_token_ids.to(
                "cpu", non_blocking=True
            )
            self._logprobs_tensors_cpu = (
                self._logprobs_tensors.to_cpu_nonblocking()
                if self._logprobs_tensors
                else None
            )
            self._num_nans_cpu = (
                self._num_nans.to("cpu", non_blocking=True)
                if self._num_nans is not None
                else None
            )
            if check_ep_fault:
                has_fault = get_ep_all2all_manager().query_fault()
                self._has_fault = has_fault.to("cpu", non_blocking=True)
            self.async_copy_ready_event.record()

    def get_output(self) -> ModelRunnerOutput:
        """Copy the device tensors to the host and return a ModelRunnerOutput.

        This function blocks until the copy is finished.
        """
        max_gen_len = self.sampled_token_ids_cpu.shape[-1]
        self.async_copy_ready_event.synchronize()

        # Release the device tensors once the copy has completed.
        del self._logprobs_tensors
        del self._sampled_token_ids
        if max_gen_len == 1:
            valid_sampled_token_ids = self.sampled_token_ids_cpu.tolist()
            for i in self._invalid_req_indices:
                valid_sampled_token_ids[i].clear()
            logprobs_lists = None
            if self._logprobs_tensors_cpu is not None:
                logprobs_lists = self._logprobs_tensors_cpu.tolists()
        else:
            valid_sampled_token_ids, logprobs_lists = RejectionSampler.parse_output(
                self.sampled_token_ids_cpu,
                self.vocab_size,
                self._invalid_req_indices,
                logprobs_tensors=self._logprobs_tensors_cpu,
            )

        output = self._model_runner_output
        output.sampled_token_ids = valid_sampled_token_ids
        output.logprobs = logprobs_lists

        if self._num_nans_cpu is not None:
            output.num_nans_in_logits = nans_to_dict(
                self._num_nans_cpu.tolist(), output.req_id_to_index
            )
            if envs.VLLM_RAISE_ON_LOGIT_NANS:
                raise_if_nan_logits(output.num_nans_in_logits)
        del self._num_nans

        if self._has_fault is not None and self._has_fault.item():
            mask = get_ep_all2all_manager().query_active_mask()
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Fault detected in EP all2all communication: "
                "one or more ranks timed out during dispatch/combine. "
                f"Mask: {mask.cpu().tolist()}"
            )

        return output


def _copy_pooler_output_to_cpu(
    raw_pooler_output: PoolerOutput, finished_mask: list[bool]
) -> list[torch.Tensor | None]:
    num_reqs = len(finished_mask)

    if isinstance(raw_pooler_output, torch.Tensor):
        if raw_pooler_output.shape[0] != num_reqs:
            raise ValueError(
                "Pooler output batch size does not match finished mask size: "
                f"{raw_pooler_output.shape[0]} != {num_reqs}."
            )

        num_finished = sum(finished_mask)
        if num_finished == 0:
            return [None] * num_reqs
        if num_finished == num_reqs:
            return list(raw_pooler_output.to("cpu", non_blocking=True))

        # partial finished
        finished_indices = [i for i, include in enumerate(finished_mask) if include]
        index_tensor = torch.tensor(
            finished_indices, device=raw_pooler_output.device, dtype=torch.long
        )
        finished_outputs = raw_pooler_output.index_select(0, index_tensor).to(
            "cpu", non_blocking=True
        )
        partial_pooler_output: list[torch.Tensor | None] = [None] * num_reqs
        for i, out in zip(finished_indices, finished_outputs):
            partial_pooler_output[i] = out
        return partial_pooler_output

    assert isinstance(raw_pooler_output, list)
    if len(raw_pooler_output) != num_reqs:
        raise ValueError(
            "Pooler output batch size does not match finished mask size: "
            f"{len(raw_pooler_output)} != {num_reqs}."
        )

    pooler_output: list[torch.Tensor | None] = [None] * num_reqs
    for i, (out, include) in enumerate(zip(raw_pooler_output, finished_mask)):
        if include and out is not None:
            pooler_output[i] = out.to("cpu", non_blocking=True)
    return pooler_output


class AsyncGPUPoolingModelRunnerOutput(AsyncModelRunnerOutput):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_runner_output: ModelRunnerOutput,
        raw_pooler_output: PoolerOutput,
        finished_mask: list[bool],
        async_output_copy_stream: current_platform.torch_device_fn.Stream,
    ):
        self._model_runner_output = model_runner_output

        # Event on the copy stream so we can synchronize the non-blocking copy.
        # Blocking (sleep) event to avoid busy-polling the CUDA driver lock.
        self.async_copy_ready_event = current_platform.torch_device_fn.Event(
            blocking=True
        )

        # Keep a reference to the device tensors to avoid them being
        # deallocated until we finish copying it to the host.
        self._raw_pooler_output = raw_pooler_output

        # Initiate the copy on a separate stream, but do not synchronize it.
        default_stream = current_platform.torch_device_fn.current_stream()
        with current_platform.torch_device_fn.stream(async_output_copy_stream):
            async_output_copy_stream.wait_stream(default_stream)
            self._model_runner_output.pooler_output = _copy_pooler_output_to_cpu(
                raw_pooler_output=self._raw_pooler_output,
                finished_mask=finished_mask,
            )
            self.async_copy_ready_event.record()

    def get_output(self) -> ModelRunnerOutput:
        """Copy the device tensors to the host and return a ModelRunnerOutput.
        This function blocks until the copy is finished.
        """
        self.async_copy_ready_event.synchronize()

        # Release the device tensors once the copy has completed.
        del self._raw_pooler_output
        return self._model_runner_output


class ExecuteModelState(NamedTuple):
    """Ephemeral cached state transferred between execute_model() and
    sample_tokens(), after execute_model() returns None."""

    scheduler_output: "SchedulerOutput"
    logits: torch.Tensor
    spec_decode_metadata: SpecDecodeMetadata | None
    spec_decode_common_attn_metadata: CommonAttentionMetadata | None
    hidden_states: torch.Tensor
    sample_hidden_states: torch.Tensor
    aux_hidden_states: list[torch.Tensor] | None
    ec_connector_output: ECConnectorOutput | None
    cudagraph_stats: CUDAGraphStat | None
    slot_mappings: dict[str, torch.Tensor] | list[dict[str, torch.Tensor]] | None


class ModelRunnerFL(
    LoRAModelRunnerMixin, KVConnectorModelRunnerMixin, ECConnectorModelRunnerMixin
):
    @JitWarmupRegistry.capture
    def __init__(
        self,
        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
        device: torch.device,
    ):
        self.vllm_config = vllm_config
        self.model_config = vllm_config.model_config
        self.cache_config = vllm_config.cache_config
        self.offload_config = vllm_config.offload_config
        self.compilation_config = vllm_config.compilation_config
        self.lora_config = vllm_config.lora_config
        self.load_config = vllm_config.load_config
        self.parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
        self.scheduler_config = vllm_config.scheduler_config
        self.speculative_config = vllm_config.speculative_config
        self.observability_config = vllm_config.observability_config

        model_config = self.model_config
        cache_config = self.cache_config
        scheduler_config = self.scheduler_config
        parallel_config = self.parallel_config
        self.device = device
        self.dtype = self.model_config.dtype

        self.check_ep_fault = False
        if parallel_config.data_parallel_size > 1 and self.model_config.is_moe:
            self.check_ep_fault = get_ep_all2all_manager().support_fault_tolerance

        self.kv_cache_dtype = kv_cache_dtype_str_to_dtype(
            cache_config.cache_dtype, self.model_config
        )

        self.is_pooling_model = model_config.runner_type == "pooling"
        self.enable_prompt_embeds = model_config.enable_prompt_embeds
        self.is_multimodal_raw_input_only_model = (
            model_config.is_multimodal_raw_input_only_model
        )
        # These will be overridden in load_model()
        self.is_multimodal_pruning_enabled = False
        self.requires_sequential_video_encoding = False
        self.max_model_len = model_config.max_model_len

        # Always set to false after the first forward pass
        self.dcp_world_size = self.parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size
        self.dcp_rank = 0 if self.dcp_world_size <= 1 else get_dcp_group().rank_in_group
        self.max_num_tokens = scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens
        self.max_num_reqs = scheduler_config.max_num_seqs

        # Broadcast PP output for external_launcher (torchrun)
        # to make sure we are synced across pp ranks
        # TODO: Support overlapping micro-batches
        # https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/18019
        self.broadcast_pp_output = (
            self.parallel_config.distributed_executor_backend == "external_launcher"
            and len(get_pp_group().ranks) > 1
        )

        # Model-related.
        self.inputs_embeds_size = model_config.get_inputs_embeds_size()
        self.is_mm_prefix_lm = self.model_config.is_mm_prefix_lm
        # Deprecated: cascade attention has been removed. Kept for
        # out-of-tree model runners.
        self.cascade_attn_enabled = False

        # Multi-modal data support
        self.mm_registry = MULTIMODAL_REGISTRY
        self.uses_mrope = model_config.uses_mrope
        self.mrope_num_dims = model_config.mrope_num_dims
        self.supports_mm_inputs = model_config.supports_multimodal_inputs

        if self.model_config.is_encoder_decoder:
            # Maximum length of the encoder input, only for encoder-decoder
            # models.
            self.max_encoder_len = scheduler_config.max_num_encoder_input_tokens
        else:
            self.max_encoder_len = 0

        # Async scheduling
        self.use_async_scheduling = self.scheduler_config.async_scheduling

        # Async PP broadcast of sampled token ids, waited on in _prepare_input_ids.
        self._pp_recv_work: torch.distributed.Work | None = None

        # Sampler
        self.sampler = Sampler(
            logprobs_mode=self.model_config.logprobs_mode,
            use_fp64_gumbel=self.model_config.use_fp64_gumbel,
        )

        self.eplb_state: EplbState | None = None
        self._moe_model: MixtureOfExperts | None = None
        # NOTE(yongji): flag to temporarily disable EPLB during scaling up/down
        self.eep_eplb_suppressed = False
        """
        State of the expert parallelism load balancer.

        Will be lazily initialized when the model is loaded.
        """

        # Lazy initializations
        # self.model: nn.Module  # Set after load_model
        # Initialize in initialize_kv_cache
        self.kv_caches: list[torch.Tensor] = []
        # indexes: [kv_cache_group_id][attn_group]
        self.attn_groups: list[list[AttentionGroup]] = []
        # self.kv_cache_config: KVCacheConfig

        # mm_hash ->  encoder_output
        self.encoder_cache: dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
        self.late_interaction_runner = LateInteractionRunner()

        # Encoder CUDA graph manager (initialized after model load if enabled)
        self.encoder_cudagraph_manager: EncoderCudaGraphManager | None = None

        self.use_aux_hidden_state_outputs = False
        # Set up speculative decoding.
        # NOTE(Jiayi): currently we put the entire draft model on
        # the last PP rank. This is not ideal if there are many
        # layers in the draft model.
        if self.speculative_config and get_pp_group().is_last_rank:
            self.drafter: (
                NgramProposer  # noqa: F823
                | NgramProposerGPU
                | SuffixDecodingProposer
                | EagleProposer
                | DFlashProposer
                | DraftModelProposer
                | MedusaProposer
                | ExtractHiddenStatesProposer
                | Gemma4Proposer
                | Step3p5MTPProposer
            )
            if self.speculative_config.method == "custom_class":
                self.drafter = create_custom_proposer(  # type: ignore[assignment]
                    self.vllm_config
                )
            elif self.speculative_config.method == "ngram":
                from vllm.v1.spec_decode.ngram_proposer import NgramProposer

                self.drafter = NgramProposer(self.vllm_config)
            elif self.speculative_config.uses_draft_model():
                self.drafter = DraftModelProposer(
                    vllm_config=self.vllm_config,
                    device=self.device,
                    runner=self,
                )
            elif self.speculative_config.use_ngram_gpu():
                self.drafter = NgramProposerGPU(self.vllm_config, self.device, self)
                self.num_tokens_no_spec_gpu = torch.zeros(
                    self.max_num_reqs, dtype=torch.int32, device=device
                )
                self.token_ids_gpu_tensor = torch.zeros(
                    self.max_num_reqs,
                    self.max_model_len,
                    dtype=torch.int32,
                    device=device,
                )
                self._ngram_pinned_idx_buf = torch.zeros(
                    self.max_num_reqs, dtype=torch.long, pin_memory=True
                )
                self._ngram_pinned_val_buf = torch.zeros(
                    self.max_num_reqs, dtype=torch.int32, pin_memory=True
                )
            elif self.speculative_config.use_gemma4_mtp():
                self.drafter = Gemma4Proposer(self.vllm_config, self.device, self)
            elif self.speculative_config.use_step3p5_mtp():
                self.drafter = Step3p5MTPProposer(self.vllm_config, self.device, self)
            elif self.speculative_config.use_dflash():
                self.drafter = DFlashProposer(self.vllm_config, self.device, self)
                self.use_aux_hidden_state_outputs = True
            elif self.speculative_config.method == "suffix":
                self.drafter = SuffixDecodingProposer(self.vllm_config)
            elif self.speculative_config.use_eagle():
                self.drafter = EagleProposer(self.vllm_config, self.device, self)
                if self.speculative_config.method == "eagle3":
                    self.use_aux_hidden_state_outputs = (
                        self.drafter.eagle3_use_aux_hidden_state
                    )
            elif self.speculative_config.method == "medusa":
                self.drafter = MedusaProposer(
                    vllm_config=self.vllm_config, device=self.device
                )
            elif self.speculative_config.method == "extract_hidden_states":
                self.drafter = ExtractHiddenStatesProposer(
                    vllm_config=self.vllm_config, device=self.device
                )
                self.use_aux_hidden_state_outputs = True
            else:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Unknown speculative decoding method: "
                    f"{self.speculative_config.method}"
                )
            self.rejection_sampler = RejectionSampler(
                self.sampler, self.speculative_config, self.device
            )

        self.num_spec_tokens = 0
        self.prev_num_spec_tokens = 0
        self.valid_sampled_token_count_gpu: torch.Tensor | None = None
        if self.speculative_config:
            self.num_spec_tokens = self.speculative_config.num_speculative_tokens
            self.prev_num_spec_tokens = self.num_spec_tokens
            draft_config = self.speculative_config.draft_model_config
            if draft_config is not None and draft_config.max_model_len is not None:
                self.effective_drafter_max_model_len = draft_config.max_model_len
            else:
                self.effective_drafter_max_model_len = self.max_model_len
        self.use_async_spec_decode = (
            self.use_async_scheduling and self.num_spec_tokens > 0
        )

        # Request states.
        self.requests: dict[str, CachedRequestState] = {}
        # NOTE(rob): num_prompt_logprobs only includes reqs
        # that are currently in the prefill phase.
        self.num_prompt_logprobs: dict[str, int] = {}

        # Input Batch
        # NOTE(Chen): Ideally, we should initialize the input batch inside
        # `initialize_kv_cache` based on the kv cache config. However, as in
        # https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/18298, due to some unknown
        # reasons, we have to initialize the input batch before `load_model`,
        # quantization + weight offloading will fail otherwise. As a temporary
        # solution, we initialize the input batch here, and re-initialize it
        # in `initialize_kv_cache` if the block_sizes here is different from
        # the block_sizes in the kv cache config.
        logits_processors = model_config.logits_processors
        custom_logitsprocs: Sequence[str | type[LogitsProcessor]] = (
            tuple(logits_processors) if logits_processors is not None else ()
        )
        placeholder_block_size = (
            self.cache_config.block_size or CacheConfig.DEFAULT_BLOCK_SIZE
        )
        placeholder_max_num_blocks = cdiv(
            max(self.max_model_len, self.max_encoder_len), placeholder_block_size
        )
        self._init_block_sizes = [placeholder_block_size]
        self._init_max_num_blocks = [placeholder_max_num_blocks]
        self._init_slot_mapping_modes = [SlotMappingMode.TOKEN_TO_KV_SLOT]
        self.cp_kv_cache_interleave_size = (
            self.parallel_config.cp_kv_cache_interleave_size
        )
        # Capture warmup providers registered by the initial placeholder InputBatch
        self.input_batch = InputBatch(
            max_num_reqs=self.max_num_reqs,
            # We need to use the encoder length for encoder-decoder
            # because of KV cache for cross-attention.
            max_model_len=max(self.max_model_len, self.max_encoder_len),
            max_num_batched_tokens=self.max_num_tokens,
            device=self.device,
            vocab_size=self.model_config.get_vocab_size(),
            block_sizes=[placeholder_block_size],
            max_num_blocks_per_req=[placeholder_max_num_blocks],
            num_spec_tokens=self.num_spec_tokens,
            logitsprocs=build_logitsprocs(
                self.vllm_config,
                self.device,
                PIN_MEMORY,
                self.is_pooling_model,
                custom_logitsprocs,
            ),
            # We currently don't know whether a particular custom logits processor
            # uses output token ids so we set this conservatively. Thinking-budget
            # tracking is requested dynamically when a budgeted request is in the
            # batch.
            logitsprocs_need_output_token_ids=bool(custom_logitsprocs),
            is_pooling_model=self.is_pooling_model,
            cp_kv_cache_interleave_size=self.parallel_config.cp_kv_cache_interleave_size,
            reasoning_config=self.vllm_config.reasoning_config,
            use_replayssm=self.cache_config.use_replayssm,
        )

        # Separate cuda stream for overlapping transfer of sampled token ids from
        # GPU to CPU when async scheduling is enabled.
        self.async_output_copy_stream: (
            current_platform.torch_device_fn.Stream | None
        ) = None
        # cuda event to synchronize use of reused CPU tensors between steps
        # when async scheduling is enabled.

            and self.compilation_config.cudagraph_mode != CUDAGraphMode.NONE

                self.compilation_config.cudagraph_capture_sizes

        else:

        self.input_ids = self._make_buffer(self.max_num_tokens, dtype=torch.int32)

        self.query_start_loc = self._make_buffer(
            self.max_num_reqs + 1, dtype=torch.int32

        self.seq_lens = torch.zeros(
            self.max_num_reqs, dtype=torch.int32, device=self.device
        )
        self.optimistic_seq_lens_cpu = torch.zeros(
            self.max_num_reqs, dtype=torch.int32, pin_memory=PIN_MEMORY
        )
        self.num_computed_tokens = torch.zeros(
            self.max_num_reqs, dtype=torch.int32, device=self.device

        self.prev_num_draft_tokens = self._make_buffer(
            self.max_num_reqs, dtype=torch.int32

        self.req_indices = self._make_buffer(self.max_num_tokens, dtype=torch.int64)
        # Maps current batch position -> previous batch position (-1 for new reqs)

        self.num_scheduled_tokens = self._make_buffer(
            self.max_num_reqs, dtype=torch.int32

                self.max_num_reqs, dtype=torch.int32

        # Because inputs_embeds may be bfloat16 and we don't need a numpy
        # version of this tensor, avoid a RuntimeError by not creating a
        # numpy buffer.
        self.inputs_embeds = self._make_buffer(
            self.max_num_tokens, self.inputs_embeds_size, dtype=self.dtype, numpy=False

        self.is_token_ids = self._make_buffer(self.max_num_tokens, dtype=torch.bool)
        self.discard_request_mask = self._make_buffer(
            self.max_num_reqs, dtype=torch.bool
        )
        self.num_decode_draft_tokens = self._make_buffer(
            self.max_num_reqs, dtype=torch.int32

        self.num_accepted_tokens = self._make_buffer(
            self.max_num_reqs, dtype=torch.int32

            # position on purpose to make it non-contiguous so that it can work
            # with torch compile.
            # See detailed explanation in https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/12128#discussion_r1926431923

            # NOTE: For text-only inputs, each dimension has identical position
            # IDs, making M-RoPE functionally equivalent to 1D-RoPE.
            # See page 5 of https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.12191

            )

            MultiModalBudget(self.vllm_config, self.mm_registry)
            if self.supports_mm_inputs
            else None
        )

        # (e.g., KV sharing, encoder-only attention), but not in the

        self.runner_only_attn_layers: set[str] = set()

        self._draft_prob_req_ids: list[str] | None = None

        self._num_valid_draft_tokens: torch.Tensor | None = None
        self._num_valid_draft_tokens_cpu: torch.Tensor | None = None
        self._num_valid_draft_tokens_event: (

        ) = None
        self._num_valid_draft_tokens_copy_stream: (

        ) = None

        self.transfer_event = torch.Event()

            device="cpu",
            pin_memory=PIN_MEMORY,
        )

        self.valid_sampled_token_count_copy_stream: (
            current_platform.torch_device_fn.Stream | None
        ) = None

        self.draft_token_ids_copy_stream: (
            current_platform.torch_device_fn.Stream | None
        ) = None
        self.valid_sampled_token_count_cpu: torch.Tensor | None = None
        self.draft_token_ids_cpu: torch.Tensor | None = None
        self.num_accepted_tokens_event: torch.Event | None = None
        if self.num_spec_tokens:
            self.draft_token_ids_event = torch.Event()
            self.num_accepted_tokens_event = torch.Event()
            self.draft_token_ids_copy_stream = current_platform.torch_device_fn.Stream()
            self.draft_token_ids_cpu = torch.empty(

    @managed_inference_mode()
    def init_fp8_kv_scales(self) -> None:
        """
        Re-initialize the KV cache and FP8 scales after waking from sleep.
        1. Zero out the KV cache tensors to remove garbage data from re-allocation.
        2. Reset Attention layer scaling factors (_k_scale, _v_scale) to 1.0.
          If these are left at 0.0 (default after wake_up), all KV cache values
          become effectively zero, causing gibberish output.
        """
        if not is_quantized_kv_cache(self.cache_config.cache_dtype):
            return

        kv_caches = getattr(self, "kv_caches", [])
        for cache_entry in kv_caches:
            if cache_entry is None:
                continue
            # Hybrid models (Mamba, DeltaNet) store per-layer state as a
            # list of tensors rather than a single tensor.
            if isinstance(cache_entry, list):
                for t in cache_entry:
                    t.zero_()
            else:
                cache_entry.zero_()

        k_attr_names = ("_k_scale", "k_scale")
        v_attr_names = ("_v_scale", "v_scale")

        attn_layers = self.compilation_config.static_forward_context
        for name, module in attn_layers.items():
            if isinstance(module, (Attention, MLAAttention)):
                # TODO: Generally, scale is 1.0 if user uses on-the-fly fp8
                # kvcache quant. However, to get better accuracy, compression
                # frameworks like llm-compressors allow users to tune the
                # scale. We may need to restore the specific calibrated scales
                # here in the future.
                k_scale_val, v_scale_val = 1.0, 1.0

                # Processing K Scale
                for attr in k_attr_names:
                    if hasattr(module, attr):
                        param = getattr(module, attr)
                        if isinstance(param, torch.Tensor):
                            param.fill_(k_scale_val)

                # Processing V Scale
                for attr in v_attr_names:
                    if hasattr(module, attr):
                        param = getattr(module, attr)
                        if isinstance(param, torch.Tensor):
                            param.fill_(v_scale_val)

    def _get_positions(self, num_tokens: Any):
        if isinstance(num_tokens, int):
            if self.uses_mrope:
                return self.mrope_positions.gpu[:, :num_tokens]
            return self.positions[:num_tokens]
        else:
            if self.uses_mrope:
                return self.mrope_positions.gpu[:, num_tokens]
            return self.positions[num_tokens]

    def _make_buffer(
        self, *size: int | torch.SymInt, dtype: torch.dtype, numpy: bool = True
    ) -> CpuGpuBuffer:
        return CpuGpuBuffer(
            *size,
            dtype=dtype,
            device=self.device,
            with_numpy=numpy,
        )

    def _get_mamba_state_copy_funcs(self) -> MambaStateCopyFuncsByType:
        if self._mamba_state_copy_funcs is None:
            mamba_groups = mamba_utils.get_mamba_groups(self.kv_cache_config)
            mamba_types = {spec.mamba_type for spec in mamba_groups}
            copy_funcs = self.model.get_mamba_state_copy_funcs(mamba_types)
            mamba_utils.validate_mamba_state_copy_funcs(mamba_groups, copy_funcs)
            self._mamba_state_copy_funcs = copy_funcs
        return self._mamba_state_copy_funcs

    def _get_mamba_bufs(self) -> mamba_utils.MambaBuffers:
        # Only reachable on the ``mamba_cache_mode == "align"`` path.
        # The postprocess sub-object is additionally gated on spec
        # decode + hybrid model.
        assert self.cache_config.mamba_cache_mode == "align"
        if self._mamba_bufs is None:
            self._mamba_bufs = mamba_utils.MambaBuffers.create(
                max_num_reqs=self.max_num_reqs,
                kv_cache_config=self.kv_cache_config,
                copy_funcs=self._get_mamba_state_copy_funcs(),
                make_buffer=self._make_buffer,
                device=self.device,
                with_postprocess_align=(
                    self.speculative_config is not None and self.model_config.is_hybrid
                ),
            )
        return self._mamba_bufs

    def _prepare_lookback_token_ids(self, num_reqs: int) -> torch.Tensor:
        """Gather, per request, the `depth` prompt token ids preceding its
        first scheduled token (column j is position start - 1 - j); -1 where
        the position is before the prompt or already past it. Generated
        positions are left to the model: under async scheduling the CPU token
        table holds placeholders for them."""
        buf = self.lookback_token_ids
        assert buf is not None
        buf.np.fill(-1)
        if num_reqs > 0:
            depth = buf.np.shape[1]
            starts = self.input_batch.num_computed_tokens_cpu[:num_reqs, None]
            pos = starts - np.arange(1, depth + 1)
            num_prompt = self.input_batch.num_prompt_tokens[:num_reqs, None]
            valid = (pos >= 0) & (pos < num_prompt)
            rows = np.arange(num_reqs)[:, None]
            ids = self.input_batch.token_ids_cpu[rows, np.clip(pos, 0, None)]
            buf.np[:num_reqs] = np.where(valid, ids, -1)
        return buf.copy_to_gpu()

    def _init_model_kwargs(self, num_reqs: int | None = None):
        model_kwargs = dict[str, Any]()

        if self.lookback_token_ids is not None:
            if num_reqs is None:
                num_reqs = self.input_batch.num_reqs
            model_kwargs["lookback_token_ids"] = self._prepare_lookback_token_ids(
                num_reqs
            )

        if not self.is_pooling_model:
            return model_kwargs

        num_reqs = self.input_batch.num_reqs
        pooling_params = self.input_batch.get_pooling_params()

        token_type_id_requests = dict[int, Any]()
        for i, param in enumerate(pooling_params):
            if (
                param.extra_kwargs is not None
                and (token_types := param.extra_kwargs.get("compressed_token_type_ids"))
                is not None
            ):
                token_type_id_requests[i] = token_types

        if len(token_type_id_requests) == 0:
            return model_kwargs

        # Build ids on CPU using the CPU-resident upper bound for seq_lens;
        # `torch.arange(seq_lens[i])` with a GPU scalar would force a sync.
        seq_lens_cpu = self.optimistic_seq_lens_cpu[:num_reqs].tolist()
        token_type_ids = []

        for i in range(num_reqs):
            seq_len_i = seq_lens_cpu[i]
            pos = token_type_id_requests.get(i, seq_len_i)
            ids = (torch.arange(seq_len_i) >= pos).int()
            token_type_ids.append(ids)

        token_type_ids_cpu = torch.empty(
            sum(seq_lens_cpu), dtype=torch.int32, pin_memory=PIN_MEMORY
        )
        torch.cat(token_type_ids, out=token_type_ids_cpu)
        model_kwargs["token_type_ids"] = token_type_ids_cpu.to(
            device=self.device, non_blocking=True
        )
        return model_kwargs

    def _may_reorder_batch(self, scheduler_output: "SchedulerOutput") -> None:
        """Update the order of requests in the batch based on the attention
        backend's needs. For example, some attention backends (namely MLA) may
        want to separate requests based on if the attention computation will be
        compute-bound or memory-bound.

        Args:
            scheduler_output: The scheduler output.

        """
        # Attention free models have zero kv_cache_groups, however models
        # like Mamba are also attention free but use the kv_cache for
        # keeping its internal state. This is why we check the number
        # of kv_cache groups instead of solely checking
        # for self.model_config.is_attention_free.
        if len(self.kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups) == 0:
            return

        if self.reorder_batch_threshold is not None:
            reorder_batch_to_split_decodes_and_prefills(
                self.input_batch,
                scheduler_output,
                decode_threshold=self.reorder_batch_threshold,
            )

        self._kv_block_zeroer = KVBlockZeroer(
            self.device,
            attn_groups_iter=self._kv_cache_spec_attn_group_iterator(),
            kernel_block_sizes=self._kernel_block_sizes,
            runner_only_attn_layers=self.runner_only_attn_layers,
            static_forward_context=self.compilation_config.static_forward_context,
            num_blocks=self.kv_cache_config.num_blocks,
        )

    def _zero_block_ids(self, block_ids: list[int]) -> None:
        """Zero the KV cache memory for the given block IDs."""
        if hasattr(self, "_kv_block_zeroer"):
            self._kv_block_zeroer.zero_block_ids(block_ids)

    def _update_states(self, scheduler_output: "SchedulerOutput") -> Callable | None:
        """Update the cached states and the persistent batch with the scheduler
        output.

        The updated states are used by the `_prepare_inputs` function to create
        the input GPU tensors for the model.

        The SamplingMetadata is updated and copied to the GPU if there is a
        new/resumed/paused/finished request in the batch.
        """
        # Remove finished requests from the cached states.
        for req_id in scheduler_output.finished_req_ids:
            req_state = self.requests.pop(req_id, None)
            self._on_request_state_removed(req_id, req_state)
            self.num_prompt_logprobs.pop(req_id, None)
        self.late_interaction_runner.on_requests_finished(
            scheduler_output.finished_req_ids
        )
        # Remove the finished requests from the persistent batch.
        # NOTE(woosuk): There could be an edge case where finished_req_ids and
        # scheduled_req_ids overlap. This happens when a request is aborted and
        # then resubmitted with the same ID. In this case, we treat them as two
        # distinct requests - clearing the cached states for the first request
        # and handling the second as a new request.
        for req_id in scheduler_output.finished_req_ids:
            self.input_batch.remove_request(req_id)

        # Zero GPU memory for freshly allocated cache blocks to prevent
        # stale NaN/data from corrupting attention or SSM computation.
        if scheduler_output.new_block_ids_to_zero:
            self._zero_block_ids(scheduler_output.new_block_ids_to_zero)
        if scheduler_output.kv_cache_block_copies:
            copy_kv_cache_blocks_inplace(
                self.kv_caches,
                self.kv_cache_config.num_blocks,
                scheduler_output.kv_cache_block_copies,
            )

        # Free the cached encoder outputs.
        self._process_encoder_cache_scheduler_output(scheduler_output)

        # Remove the unscheduled requests from the persistent batch.
        # NOTE(woosuk): The unscheduled requests are either preempted requests
        # or running requests that are not scheduled in this step. We remove
        # them from the persistent batch but keep their cached states since
        # they will be scheduled again sometime in the future.
        scheduled_req_ids = scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens.keys()
        cached_req_ids = self.input_batch.req_id_to_index.keys()
        resumed_req_ids = scheduler_output.scheduled_cached_reqs.resumed_req_ids
        # NOTE(zhuohan): cached_req_ids and resumed_req_ids are usually disjoint,
        # so `(scheduled_req_ids - resumed_req_ids) == scheduled_req_ids` holds
        # apart from the forced-preemption case in reset_prefix_cache. And in
        # that case we include the resumed_req_ids in the unscheduled set so
        # that they get cleared from the persistent batch before being re-scheduled
        # in the normal resumed request path.
        unscheduled_req_ids = cached_req_ids - (scheduled_req_ids - resumed_req_ids)
        # NOTE(woosuk): The persistent batch optimization assumes that
        # consecutive batches contain mostly the same requests. If batches
        # have low request overlap (e.g., alternating between two distinct
        # sets of requests), this optimization becomes very inefficient.
        for req_id in unscheduled_req_ids:
            self.input_batch.remove_request(req_id)

        is_ngram_gpu = (
            self.speculative_config is not None
            and self.speculative_config.use_ngram_gpu()
        )
        if is_ngram_gpu:
            ngram_gpu_new_reqs: list[CachedRequestState] = []

        reqs_to_add: list[CachedRequestState] = []
        deferred_spec_decode_corrections = []

        # Add new requests to the cached states.
        for new_req_data in scheduler_output.scheduled_new_reqs:
            req_id = new_req_data.req_id
            if req_id in self.requests:
                # For streaming case only.
                req_state = self._update_streaming_request(req_id, new_req_data)
                reqs_to_add.append(req_state)
                continue

            sampling_params = new_req_data.sampling_params
            pooling_params = new_req_data.pooling_params

            if (
                sampling_params
                and sampling_params.sampling_type == SamplingType.RANDOM_SEED
            ):
                generator = torch.Generator(device=self.device)
                generator.manual_seed(sampling_params.seed)
            else:
                generator = None

            if self.is_pooling_model:
                assert pooling_params is not None
                task = pooling_params.task
                assert task is not None, "You did not set `task` in the API"

                model = cast(VllmModelForPooling, self.get_model())
                to_update = model.pooler.get_pooling_updates(task)
                to_update.apply(pooling_params)

            req_state = CachedRequestState(
                req_id=req_id,
                prompt_token_ids=new_req_data.prompt_token_ids,
                prompt_embeds=new_req_data.prompt_embeds,
                prompt_is_token_ids=new_req_data.prompt_is_token_ids,
                mm_features=new_req_data.mm_features,
                sampling_params=sampling_params,
                pooling_params=pooling_params,
                generator=generator,
                block_ids=new_req_data.block_ids,
                num_computed_tokens=new_req_data.num_computed_tokens,
                output_token_ids=[],
                lora_request=new_req_data.lora_request,
            )
            self.requests[req_id] = req_state
            self.late_interaction_runner.register_request(req_id, pooling_params)

            if sampling_params and sampling_params.prompt_logprobs is not None:
                self.num_prompt_logprobs[req_id] = (
                    self.input_batch.vocab_size
                    if sampling_params.prompt_logprobs == -1
                    else sampling_params.prompt_logprobs
                )

            # Only relevant for models using M-RoPE (e.g, Qwen2-VL)
            if self.uses_mrope:
                self._init_mrope_positions(req_state)

            reqs_to_add.append(req_state)
            # Track new requests for ngram_gpu full tensor copy
            if is_ngram_gpu:
                ngram_gpu_new_reqs.append(req_state)

        # Update the states of the running/resumed requests.
        is_last_rank = get_pp_group().is_last_rank
        req_data = scheduler_output.scheduled_cached_reqs
        scheduled_spec_tokens = scheduler_output.scheduled_spec_decode_tokens

        # Save scheduler-allocated spec lengths before trimming so
        # prev_num_draft_len keeps the optimistic count for rejection correction.
        original_num_spec_per_req: dict[str, int] = {}
        if (
            self.speculative_config is not None
            and self.speculative_config.use_ngram_gpu()
        ):
            for req_id, toks in scheduled_spec_tokens.items():
                original_num_spec_per_req[req_id] = len(toks)
            update_scheduler_for_invalid_drafts(
                self._num_valid_draft_tokens_event,
                self._num_valid_draft_tokens_cpu,
                scheduler_output,
                self.input_batch.req_id_to_index,
            )
        if self.use_async_spec_decode:
            self.prev_num_draft_tokens.np.fill(0)

        for i, req_id in enumerate(req_data.req_ids):
            req_state = self.requests[req_id]
            num_computed_tokens = req_data.num_computed_tokens[i]
            new_block_ids = req_data.new_block_ids[i]
            resumed_from_preemption = req_id in req_data.resumed_req_ids
            num_output_tokens = req_data.num_output_tokens[i]
            req_index = self.input_batch.req_id_to_index.get(req_id)

            if req_state.prev_num_draft_len and self.use_async_scheduling:
                # prev_num_draft_len is used in async scheduling mode with
                # spec decode. it indicates if need to update num_computed_tokens
                # of the request. for example:
                # first step: num_computed_tokens = 0, spec_tokens = [],
                # prev_num_draft_len = 0.
                # second step: num_computed_tokens = 100(prompt length),
                # spec_tokens = [a,b], prev_num_draft_len = 0.
                # third step: num_computed_tokens = 100 + 2, spec_tokens = [c,d],
                # prev_num_draft_len = 2.
                # num_computed_tokens in first step and second step doesn't contain
                # the spec tokens length, but in third step it contains the
                # spec tokens length. we only need to update num_computed_tokens
                # when prev_num_draft_len > 0.
                if req_index is None:
                    req_state.prev_num_draft_len = 0
                else:
                    # Optimistically assume all accepted; queue up a correction
                    # to be called after the model forward to preserve async
                    # scheduling. Corrected on GPU in _prepare_inputs.
                    optimistic_num_accepted = req_state.prev_num_draft_len
                    req_state.output_token_ids.extend([-1] * optimistic_num_accepted)

                    deferred_spec_decode_corrections.append(
                        (req_id, optimistic_num_accepted, req_state)
                    )

                    prev_req_index = (
                        self.input_batch.prev_req_id_to_index.get(req_id)
                        if self.input_batch.prev_req_id_to_index
                        else None
                    )
                    if prev_req_index is not None:
                        self.prev_num_draft_tokens.np[prev_req_index] = (
                            optimistic_num_accepted
                        )

                    if is_ngram_gpu and optimistic_num_accepted > 0:
                        self.input_batch.num_tokens_no_spec[req_index] += (
                            optimistic_num_accepted
                        )

            # Update the cached states.
            req_state.num_computed_tokens = num_computed_tokens

            if not is_last_rank:
                if not req_data.new_token_ids:
                    # Async scheduled PP: Sampled tokens propagated via GPU broadcast.
                    new_token_ids: list[int] = []
                else:
                    # Non-async scheduling with PP: The scheduler sends
                    # sampled token ids back because there's no direct communication
                    # between the first-stage worker and the last-stage worker.
                    new_token_ids = req_data.new_token_ids[i]
                    # Add the sampled token(s) from the previous step (if any).
                    # This doesn't include "unverified" tokens like spec tokens.
                    num_new_tokens = (
                        num_computed_tokens + len(new_token_ids) - req_state.num_tokens
                    )
                    if num_new_tokens == 1:
                        # Avoid slicing list in most common case.
                        req_state.output_token_ids.append(new_token_ids[-1])
                    elif num_new_tokens > 0:
                        req_state.output_token_ids.extend(
                            new_token_ids[-num_new_tokens:]
                        )
            elif num_output_tokens < len(req_state.output_token_ids):
                # Some output tokens were discarded due to a sync-KV-load
                # failure, or output_token_ids was inflated by the optimistic
                # extend above (async spec decode). Align the cached state.
                del req_state.output_token_ids[num_output_tokens:]
                if req_index is not None:
                    end_idx = (
                        self.input_batch.num_prompt_tokens[req_index]
                        + num_output_tokens
                    )
                    self.input_batch.num_tokens_no_spec[req_index] = end_idx

            # Update the block IDs.
            if not resumed_from_preemption:
                if new_block_ids is not None:
                    # Append the new blocks to the existing block IDs.
                    for block_ids, new_ids in zip(req_state.block_ids, new_block_ids):
                        block_ids.extend(new_ids)
            else:
```
